result.rationale: The trajectory shows the rescue team repeatedly funneling through the power-junction/reactor corridor where Raider Holt's scatter-blast and the reactor-instability hazard (10 dmg/turn at reactor zones) bleed the team. Engineer Imani is repeatedly attacked by Raider Holt (29 dmg turn 2, 25 dmg turn 3) and takes reactor environment damage (10 dmg turns 4, 5), dropping from 100 to 26 health. Security Chen and Imani both take reactor environment damage while positioned at reactor-entry. Meanwhile Medic Reyes successfully escorts civilian-sato but is blocked from reaching rescue-airlock by zone capacity (turn 4 contested target_zone_capacity_lost) and pirate blockers. The core bottleneck is that health/position/capacity pressure (reactor hazard, pirate overwatch, zone capacity) prevents the team from converting the recovered civilian into an extraction, and the reactor-heat climbs to 100 with cooling toggling off. This is a survival/spatial-pressure blockage rather than an information or local-policy problem.
